knots_target_consistent.name: knots_target_consistent
knots_target_consistent.value: ("knots"."target_type" = 'PROCEDURE' and "knots"."procedure_id" is not null and "knots"."run_id" is null) or ("knots"."target_type" = 'RUN' and "knots"."run_id" is not null and "knots"."procedure_id" is null)

knots_revocation_consistent.name: knots_revocation_consistent
knots_revocation_consistent.value: ("knots"."revoked_at" is null) = ("knots"."revoked_by_user_id" is null) and ("knots"."revoked_at" is null) = ("knots"."revoked_by_display_name" is null)

procedure_steps_icon_valid.name: procedure_steps_icon_valid
procedure_steps_icon_valid.value: icon is null or icon in ('checklist', 'home', 'kitchen', 'cleaning', 'laundry', 'garden', 'pet', 'car', 'travel', 'tools', 'health', 'shopping', 'document', 'security', 'star')

run_steps_icon_valid.name: run_steps_icon_valid
run_steps_icon_valid.value: icon is null or icon in ('checklist', 'home', 'kitchen', 'cleaning', 'laundry', 'garden', 'pet', 'car', 'travel', 'tools', 'health', 'shopping', 'document', 'security', 'star')

run_steps_state_change_complete.name: run_steps_state_change_complete
run_steps_state_change_complete.value: ("run_steps"."state_changed_by_user_id" is null) = ("run_steps"."state_changed_by_display_name" is null) and ("run_steps"."state_changed_by_user_id" is null) = ("run_steps"."state_changed_at" is null)

run_steps_reason_only_when_skipped_or_na.name: run_steps_reason_only_when_skipped_or_na
run_steps_reason_only_when_skipped_or_na.value: "run_steps"."state_reason" is null or ("run_steps"."state" in ('SKIPPED', 'NOT_APPLICABLE') and length(trim("run_steps"."state_reason")) > 0 and length("run_steps"."state_reason") <= 500)

runs_end_consistent.name: runs_end_consistent
runs_end_consistent.value: ("runs"."ended_at" is null) = ("runs"."state" = 'ACTIVE') and ("runs"."ended_at" is null) = ("runs"."ended_by_user_id" is null) and ("runs"."ended_at" is null) = ("runs"."ended_by_display_name" is null)

runs_end_reason_only_when_aborted.name: runs_end_reason_only_when_aborted
runs_end_reason_only_when_aborted.value: "runs"."end_reason" is null or ("runs"."state" = 'ABORTED' and length(trim("runs"."end_reason")) > 0 and length("runs"."end_reason") <= 500)
